name: doguclks-mods
description: Claude Code mods: Turkish replies, a done notification, a shield for dangerous commands, a session summary, and a live session panel.

plugins.name: turkish-mode
plugins.description: Makes Claude reply in Turkish; toggle it with /turkish.

plugins.name: done-notify
plugins.description: Plays a sound, flashes the terminal and leaves a Windows notification when a long turn finishes.

plugins.name: command-shield
plugins.description: Asks you before Claude runs a dangerous Bash or PowerShell command.

plugins.name: session-summary
plugins.description: /summary sums up what this session did, with every to-do marked done, in progress or not started.

plugins.name: session-panel
plugins.description: A live side panel: session time, turns, cost, context, to-do progress and the files Claude changed; toggle it with /panel.
